name: Hybrid Preshading with Postclassification
definition: A shading technique that uses postclassification but only preshading to maintain speed. It precomputes volume gradients and associates a quantized space direction index with every voxel.
summary: Hybrid Preshading with Postclassification is a real-time volume rendering optimization that decouples classification from shading by performing postclassification for accurate material assignment and preshading for high performance.
